user.title: Red Alert Entertainment App
user.description: Under Supervisor the add-on and its API token are detected automatically – just confirm. Otherwise enter host and port (internal port 8099) and the API token from the add-on configuration / add-on log.

data_description.api_token: Shown in the add-on configuration and written to the add-on log on first start. Leave empty only if you access the app without authentication (e.g. a standalone install).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the app. Check host/port and make sure it's running.
